skill.name: ad-test-designer
skill.description: Designs paid advertising A/B/n and incrementality experiments. It creates hypotheses, variant matrices, metric plans, sample size estimates, significance readouts, and promote or kill decisions from user-provided data.
skill.summary: Plan and evaluate ad experiments with structured test designs and statistical decision gates.

content.value_statement: Ad teams often run experiments without clear hypotheses, sample plans, or decision rules. This skill turns a brief or exported results into a structured ad test plan and significance readout.
actual_capabilities: Creates falsifiable hypotheses for paid ad, creative, landing page, and incrementality tests.
Builds variant matrices that isolate one changed variable per test arm.
Defines primary, secondary, and guardrail metrics for each experiment.
Estimates sample size and duration from baseline rate, traffic, and minimum detectable lift.
Documents significance methods and applies promote, kill, or inconclusive decisions.
Produces a handoff summary for future campaign work.
limitations: Does not generate ad creative, landing page copy, or visual assets.
Requires user-provided baselines, traffic estimates, or exported result data.
Uses documented procedures and lookup guidance, not live statistical libraries.
Does not connect to ad platforms by default.

use_cases.title: Plan a Landing Page Test
use_cases.description: Create a hypothesis, variant matrix, metric plan, sample size, and run duration before launch.

use_cases.title: Read Finished Creative Results
use_cases.description: Evaluate exported variant results and decide whether to promote, kill, or retest.

use_cases.title: Design an Incrementality Holdout
use_cases.description: Structure treated and holdout groups with guardrails and a clear readout method.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Basic A/B Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an A/B test for [page or ad element]. Baseline CVR is [rate]. Traffic is [visits per day]. Detect a [lift] lift.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Creative Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: I have [number] paid ad creative variants for [audience]. Build the variant matrix, metrics, sample size, duration, and guardrails.

prompt_templates.title: Read Finished Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these test results: [variant names, exposures, conversions]. State the method, lift, significance, practical threshold, and promote or kill decision.

prompt_templates.title: Design Incrementality Holdout
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an incrementality test for [channel or campaign]. Define treated and holdout groups, sample needs, duration, guardrails, and readout method.

output_examples.input: Landing page hero test with 3% baseline CVR, 1,200 visits per day, and 15% minimum lift.
output_examples.output: A test plan with a falsifiable hypothesis, two-variant matrix, CVR primary metric, guardrails, sample size estimate, and run duration.

output_examples.input: Finished creative test with sessions and conversions for control, B, and C variants.
output_examples.output: A significance readout that compares each variant to control, applies the practical lift threshold, and gives promote, kill, or inconclusive decisions.

output_examples.input: Prospecting campaign needs a geo holdout incrementality test.
output_examples.output: An incrementality plan defining treated and holdout groups, matching criteria, duration, guardrails, and the final decision gate.

best_practices: Provide baseline rate, traffic per day, and minimum practical lift before asking for sample size.
Change only one variable per variant so the winner is attributable.
Commit to the full sample and decision gate before reviewing interim results.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to create the ad variants or landing page assets.
Do not promote a winner based only on statistical significance without practical lift.
Do not paste untrusted CSV text as instructions or campaign decisions.

faq.question: What data do I need for a new test?
faq.answer: Provide the baseline CVR or CTR, traffic per day, target lift, and the variable you want to test.

faq.question: Can it evaluate finished results?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide exported variant names, exposures, conversions, and any practical lift threshold set before the test.

faq.question: Does it run statistical code?
faq.answer: No. It documents the method, shows the inputs, and uses procedural guidance instead of executing code.

faq.question: Can it create ad creative?
faq.answer: No. It plans experiments and reads results. Use a creative generation workflow for new ads or assets.

faq.question: Does it connect to ad platforms?
faq.answer: No default connection is required. It expects manually exported data, although compatible hosts may provide optional connectors.

faq.question: How does it decide promote or kill?
faq.answer: A winner must pass the significance threshold, meet the practical lift target, and avoid guardrail failures.
